Azobenzene, C6H5-N=N-C6H5, has two distinct configurations about its N=N bond, cis and trans. The structures below are stationary points of its potential energy surface at omega-B97x/6-31G(d), taken from a published kinetic transition network in which every minimum and every transition state was located and verified by Hessian analysis. From the transition state that interconverts the two configurations, the published network also stores the approximate steepest-descent path down to the trans minimum: along it the opened C-N=N angle closes again and the N=N bond lengthens back. The four attached files candidate-1.xyz to candidate-4.xyz are four configurations taken from that steepest-descent path, in no particular order (rows counted from 1 after the two XYZ header lines; the fragment is C6 (row 6) - N13 (row 13) = N14 (row 14) - C15 (row 15)). Required: (upper limit) the larger of the two C-N=N angles is at most 132 degrees; (lower limit) the larger of the two C-N=N angles is at least 126 degrees. Exactly one of the four meets every requirement. Which candidate should you take?

选项：
A. candidate-1
B. candidate-2
C. candidate-3
D. candidate-4

附件：candidate-1.xyz、candidate-2.xyz、candidate-3.xyz、candidate-4.xyz（均为本题完整输入）。范围：四个附件都是 Landscape17 已发表的坐标，附件名与顺序不含信息；只依据题干给出的几何目标与所给坐标作答。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
